nodes.description: Private owner address; controls onlyOwner-gated functions and can be silently rewritten by SetBurnAddress using roses.
Secondary privileged address set to the deployer at construction; used by SetBurnAddress to restore ownership without any access check.
Token balance mapping mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Allowance mapping written by _approve; can be forced to the constant 393 when namibia[owner] is true.
Public whitelist/flag mapping controlling whether an account is exempt from the pictures transfer cap and whether namibia is randomized.
Public flag mapping that gates random behaviour and allowance override; only settable by the owner through CheckThisAddress or implicitly in _transfer.
One-shot flag initialised true; on the first transfer from creator it whitelists the recipient and then flips to false.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Per-transfer cap threshold derived from _totalSupply/1e12 in the constructor and arbitrarily rewritable by BurnThelP.
Copy of pictures written in the constructor; unused elsewhere (dead state).
Token decimals returned by decimals().
Token symbol returned by symbol().
Token name returned by name().
One-shot flag initialised true; on the first approve from creator it whitelists the spender and then flips to false.
Deployer address used in _transfer and _approve to trigger special one-time whitelisting logic.
Monotonically increasing counter used as entropy input by randomItIs.
Initialises creator, flags, metadata, total supply, pictures cap and initial balances/whitelists for the deployer.
Modifier that reverts unless _owner equals _msgSender(); note it is NOT applied to SetBurnAddress.
Returns the current _owner.
Owner-only function that sets _owner to the zero address.
Unguarded function that transfers ownership to roses, allowing anyone to hijack ownership of the token.

Returns the balance of an account.
Returns the allowance of a spender for an owner.
External entry point that writes approvals through _approve.
Owner-only function that overwrites the pictures cap, changing the effective transfer limit globally.
External entry point that moves tokens and decrements allowance.
Adds to the caller's allowance for a spender.
Subtracts from the caller's allowance for a spender.
Owner-only unlimited mint function that inflates _totalSupply and the owner balance.
Owner-only function that flips gambler and namibia flags for an arbitrary address, i.e. a discretionary blacklist/whitelist.
Core transfer routine containing hidden one-time whitelisting, random flag assignment and a cap check gated on gambler.
Internal minting that grows total supply and recipient balance.
Internal burning that shrinks account balance and total supply.
Core approval routine containing hidden one-time whitelisting and a namibia-driven allowance override to 393.
Burns tokens and then decrements the caller's allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for balances, flags, entropy and ownership checks.
Block timestamp (now) consumed by randomItIs as randomness entropy, making transfer-side effects miner-influenceable.
Pseudo-randomness derived from now, msg.sender and a counter, then used to set namibia flags during transfers.
SSetBurnAddress changes _owner to roses with no onlyOwner guard, letting any account seize ownership.
Owner can arbitrarily set gambler/namibia flags, effectively censoring or exempting any address from transfer limits.
If namibia[owner] is true the approved amount is silently replaced with the constant 393, corrupting allowance accounting.
Transfer cap require(amount < pictures) applies only when gambler[sender] is false, giving flagged accounts an unrestricted overflow path and inconsistent supply semantics.
Owner can mint unbounded new supply, diluting holders.
Owner can overwrite pictures, the cap used in _transfer, arbitrarily changing who can move large amounts.

edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to set creator, initial balance and gambler flag.
_msgSender returns msg.sender which is the base of all authorization decisions.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against _owner to authorize calls.
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable for the authorization check.
creator is assigned msg.sender during construction.
leuko is initialized to true in the constructor.
gimbl is initialized to true in the constructor.
Token name is written in the constructor.
Token symbol is written in the constructor.
Decimals are written in the constructor.
_totalSupply is initialized in the constructor.
pictures is computed as _totalSupply / 1000000000000, an arithmetic derivation of the transfer cap.
deod is set equal to pictures in the constructor.
namibia[creator] is explicitly set to false in the constructor.
_balances[msg.sender] is seeded with the whole supply.
gambler[msg.sender] is set to true, whitelisting the deployer.
SetBurnAddress reads roses, a privileged address captured at construction time.
SetBurnAddress writes _owner, transferring full control of the contract.
Execution reaches the unguarded ownership reassignment modelled by the unsafe operation.
renounceOwnership zeroes _owner, permanently removing owner privileges.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership delegates to the internal _transferOwnership.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
_transferOwnership writes the new value into _owner.
ViewSomething returns the pictures cap.
getOwner returns the result of owner().
name() returns the stored _name.
symbol() returns the stored _symbol.
decimals() returns the stored _decimals.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads from the _balances mapping.
allowance reads from the _allowances mapping.
transfer forwards execution to _transfer.
approve forwards execution to _approve.
transferFrom moves tokens through _transfer.
transferFrom rewrites the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes through _approve, which may override the value to 393.
increaseAllowance reads the current allowance before adding.
decreaseAllowance writes through _approve, which may override the value to 393.
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance before subtracting.
PrinterSaysBrrr mints new supply to the owner through _mint.
Unbounded owner minting is the unsafe operation realized by PrinterSaysBrrr.
CheckThisAddress overwrites gambler flags, controlling who is exempt from the transfer cap.
CheckThisAddress overwrites namibia flags, which later force the allowance override.
Discretionary blacklist/whitelist management performed by the owner.
BurnThelP rewrites pictures, the cap consulted by _transfer.
Cap overwrite is the unsafe operation executed by BurnThelP.
BurnThelP is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
_transfer compares sender with creator to trigger the one-time whitelist.
_transfer reads and flips the leuko one-shot flag.
_transfer reads gambler for both sender and recipient.
_transfer reads and writes namibia flags based on transfer context.
_transfer debits and credits _balances using SafeMath sub/add.
_transfer enforces require(amount < pictures), a cap comparison using the mutable arithmetic-derived limit.
_transfer calls randomItIs to decide the namibia flag, making transfer behaviour miner-influenceable.
The gambler-gated cap check is the unsafe operation performed inside _transfer.
randomItIs consumes now as entropy, creating timestamp dependence.
randomItIs mixes msg.sender into the pseudo-random seed.
randomItIs reads and increments the party counter.
randomItIs is the unsafe pseudo-random generator node.
Block timestamp feeds the keccak seed that drives flag assignment, i.e. timestamp dependency.
msg.sender is an entropy input of the pseudo-random generator.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath add.
_mint increases the recipient balance with SafeMath add.
_burn decreases the account balance with SafeMath sub.
_burn decreases _totalSupply with SafeMath sub.
_burnFrom first destroys tokens through _burn.
_burnFrom then reduces the caller allowance through _approve.
_approve writes the resulting value into _allowances.
_approve reads and flips the one-shot gimbl flag for creator approvals.
_approve silently whitelists the spender in gambler on the first creator approval.
_approve reads namibia[owner] to decide whether to overwrite the allowance.
_approve compares owner with creator to enable the hidden whitelist branch.
Allowance override to the constant 393 is the unsafe operation inside _approve.
